_doc: Pexels image overrides — frozen pass. Per-slot override of query / pinned photo_id / avoid_terms / editorial_notes / approved_visual flag. NEVER contains the API key. Read by apps/core/pexels.py at fetch time. Backward-compatible with SITE_IMAGE_SLOTS: missing entries fall back to the slot default. The 15 photo_id below have been visually validated; freeze ensures `--all --force` reproduces exactly the same images.
